summary: All five issues checked against the code and fixed; none rejected. Commit 81d7a5b4f. (1) session list: methods.go and SessionListRequest say parent narrows the list to direct children, so the skill now says omit parent to search the room, parent gives only immediate children. (2) beforeSeq: events.go uses seq<? (exclusive) and returns the newest page DESC, reversed; the skill now says seq+1 and page back with beforeSeq set to the oldest seq returned. (3) journal: removed the asserted dyna-next.service default; the unit found with list-units goes into UNIT, then a one-line journalctl --user -u "$UNIT" --since -1h --no-pager, then search the output for the box ID. (4) recovery: added the experiment rule (note profile and parent from session list, set them back the same way; dyna session set-account SESSION auto undoes an account pin), marked restart and close as no undo in the table, and added a closing check that session list shows the box ready with a new turn or later lastOutcome and transcript read shows progress. (5) overlap: removed the refresh scheduling/volume, restart volume and close archive explanations repeated from the tool descriptions; kept stop-before-refresh and move-children-before-close. Small rewordings elsewhere keep the file within the test's 150-line limit. go test ./box/skills passes; no test expectations needed changing.
unverified: dyna session set-account SESSION auto is taken from the brief (parallel code PR) and is not in this tree; its exact undo semantics (auto vs. a previously pinned account) are not checked. session list does not show the account, so the skill offers auto rather than 'restore the previous account'.
The room log tool reaching the store's eventsPage with beforeSeq unchanged (no extra clamping in the engine handler) was not traced beyond store/events.go.
